subject.title: Control UI: Pinned context panel for user-defined persistent facts

question: Should pinned user facts be a first-party Control UI memory feature now, folded into the broader memory-file panel, or deferred until a Control UI plugin contribution-slot seam defines panels?
rationale: The requested panel changes persistent context and sensitive user data behavior, while current main only supports raw allowlisted file editing and related items do not choose the storage, injection, freshness, or security contract.

options.title: Keep canonical pinned-facts design
options.body: Use this issue to settle pinned-fact storage, injection, stale-fact, diff-preview, and security behavior before any implementation PR is queued.

options.title: Fold into memory panel
options.body: Treat the first version as part of the broader MEMORY.md/USER.md memory panel if maintainers want raw memory editing to own the UX.

options.title: Defer to plugin panel seam
options.body: Wait for the Control UI plugin contribution-slot direction if maintainers want memory/context panels to be plugin-contributed rather than bespoke core UI.

recommendation.title: Keep canonical pinned-facts design
recommendation.body: Use this issue to settle pinned-fact storage, injection, stale-fact, diff-preview, and security behavior before any implementation PR is queued.

likelyOwner.reason: Current source history points to steipete on the present Control UI/gateway file paths, and the decision crosses product, gateway, and security boundaries.
